## Where the data comes from

Reasoning RL data is all verifiable: 26K math, 17K code, 22K STEM multiple-choice and 15K logic prompts. Math proofs are excluded because correctness is hard to check automatically. Math and STEM rewards are binary (matches the reference or not). General data (66K helpfulness prompts, plus harmlessness data) relies on reward models.

Cold-start data were made by sampling R1-Zero outputs, keeping those with correct answers and a readable format, then having DeepSeek-V3 and human annotators rewrite them into a natural, single-language, first-person style. For the 800K SFT set, reasoning samples came from rejection sampling the stage-2 checkpoint, with chaotic, mixed-language or overly long outputs filtered out. Most samples are single-turn.

The authors add a caution: the vivid human-like reasoning style reflects engineered heuristics, not evidence that the model has human-like intelligence.
